_note: Investigation profiles (spec section 2). Every profile lists the verified extraction items or anchors that support it; build re-locates each anchor. Unit conversions (psi/mbar -> kPa) are marked 'converted'. conditions.*.basis states whether a value is stated in the experiment's own documents or inferred.

profiles.hardware_family: ISS Microgravity Science Glovebox (MSG) - SAME smoke-generation and diagnostics hardware
profiles.objectives: Obtain measurements of smoke from spacecraft-type fire sources (overheated materials) to enable better design of future spacecraft smoke detectors; quantify the particle size reached in low gravity.
profiles.sample_geometry: Small cylinders of material (about 3 mm diameter) wrapped by a resistively heated steel wire; 30 samples (6 per material).

o2_vol_pct.basis: inferred: SAME report says only 'air' inside the MSG and lists no gas-composition variation; the 2021 white paper (Table 1) gives the MSG atmosphere as 21% O2 at 14.7 psi

airflow_cm_s.basis: stated (flow design range over the sample)

sensors: ionization chamber from a commercial smoke detector (M1)
two DustTrak photometers with 1 um and 10 um impactors (mass, M3)
profiles.n_tests: 47 flight test records (30 initial heatings + 17 reheats); 17 primary heating runs of the five dashboard materials in the PSI workbook
profiles.independence_note: Reheats and secondary aging are not independent tests; Model C groups by sample.
profiles.similarities_differences: Same hardware as SAME-R; SAME-R added Pyrell, higher temperatures, zero-flow heating and the MPASS two-moment instrument. Pyrolysis smoke only, unlike Saffire's flaming fires.
data_files: PSI-101 combined analysed workbook (includes SAME results)

profiles.hardware_family: ISS Microgravity Science Glovebox (MSG) - SAME hardware reused on orbit
profiles.objectives: Re-fly SAME with rebuilt thermal precipitators, extend conditions (higher temperature, zero flow, Pyrell) and demonstrate a two-moment smoke detector (MPASS).
profiles.sample_geometry: Same carousel samples as SAME; six preloaded carousels plus 30 loose samples.

o2_vol_pct.basis: inferred: SAME-R report states no O2 or pressure; same MSG facility (21% O2, 14.7 psi per 2021 Table 1)

airflow_cm_s.basis: stated (baseline 8 cm/s, down to 2 cm/s, 11 zero-flow tests)

heating_s.basis: stated in run index (60 s; one 120 s run)

aging_s.basis: stated in run index (11 s typical; 720 s for some runs)

profiles.n_tests: 67 heating runs (abstract says 66 test points), 109 entries including secondary-aging readings
profiles.independence_note: Two reburn runs reuse samples; secondary-aging entries are repeated measurements of one smoke batch.
profiles.similarities_differences: Same hardware family and atmosphere as SAME; different materials (Pyrell for DBP), wider temperature and flow range. Kapton and Teflon detector responses differ markedly from SAME (see campaign records).

profiles.hardware_family: NASA GRC Gases and Aerosols from Smoldering Polymers (GASP) laboratory, 1 g
profiles.objectives: Test whether laboratory reference aerosols can act as transfer standards for spacecraft smoke-detector testing.
profiles.sample_geometry: Tube-furnace oxidative pyrolysis of gram-scale samples; smoke injected into a mixed chamber.

o2_vol_pct.basis: 2021 white paper Table 1 lists GASP at 21% O2

profiles.n_tests: Three tests per material for most materials; one PMMA test
profiles.similarities_differences: Uses the same two heritage detector types as SAME but at 1 g and without alarm decisions; adds Nomex, PMMA and wire insulation.

profiles.hardware_family: Uncrewed Cygnus cargo vehicle: Saffire flow unit + Far Field Diagnostics (FFD)
profiles.dates: Saffire IV-VI flights; analysis published 2026 (ICES; NTRS 20260001992)
profiles.objectives: Large-scale low-gravity flame spread, heat release and smoke/gas emission, including time-to-alarm versus habitability.
profiles.sample_geometry: Flat samples 40 cm wide (PMMA 0.5 or 1.0 cm thick, one- or two-sided burning); fabric samples.
sensors: ionization sensor from a commercial smoke detector
smoke_detectors_evaluated: assumed 2 mg/m3 threshold on DRX aerosol mass

detector_material_tests.detector: commercial ionization sensor + DustTrak DRX with assumed 2 mg/m3 alarm point

profiles.n_tests: Seven burns with heat/smoke data (four PMMA, two SIBAL, one cotton)
profiles.similarities_differences: Flaming, large-scale fires at exploration-like atmospheres, unlike SAME's pyrolysis smoke at cabin air; no ISS or Shuttle detector evaluated.
